body.statement: Write \(A_n=(A_{n1},\ldots,A_{nn})^{\top}\). On \(\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\), the unique exact-balancing weights imply \(Q_n^{\top}d_n=0\) and \(\mathbb E[\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2\mid Q_n,A_n]=\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+\operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^{\top})\), with \(L_n=(Q_n^\top Q_n)^{-1}Q_n^\top\) on this event. At \(\gamma=1\), on the same certified event, the two terms and their covariance corrections admit deterministic resolvent limits under the original same-sample entropy weights on an interval containing \(\kappa=1/8\), and the resulting limit recovers \(r_E=\kappa/(8\lambda)+o(\kappa)\) as \(\kappa\downarrow0\). No identity or entropy-balance conclusion is asserted for the uniform fallback on the complement.
body.justification: This is the early kill test for whether coherent leverage and Jacobian terms have a finite closure.
body.gap: LuYangWang2025 controls proportional linear and quadratic leverage for regression adjustment, but the diagonal weights here are endogenous exponential tilts sharing the same Gaussian rows.
body.consumer: Passing this test validates the strong-penalty benchmark required to trust any full phase diagram.

obligation.what_is_open: A deterministic equivalent for the two endogenous same-sample entropy-weighted resolvent terms at signal one, including verification of the explicit leverage conditions that deliver conditional concentration and a uniform small-aspect-ratio link to fixed-penalty regret.
obligation.obstruction: With \(H_n=(L_nD_n)^{\top}(L_nD_n)\), the exact variance reduction leaves the random quantities \(\|H_nu_n\|_2^2\) and \(\|H_n\|_{\mathrm F}^2\), while the conditional mean contains two further functions of the same Gaussian rows and exponential tilts. No frozen result controls these jointly or permits the proportional-limit and small-aspect-ratio limits to be interchanged.
obligation.attempted: The exact balance cancellation, conditional Bernoulli mean decomposition, full conditional variance calculation, and a Chebyshev reduction to explicit weighted-leverage norms were completed. Marginal-weight and independent-weight substitutions were rejected because they remove the coherent same-row response terms.
obligation.partial_result:
The finite-sample claim is exact.  On
\(\mathcal G_n=\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\), the established balance identity gives
\[
 Q_n^{\top}d_n=0,
 \qquad
 \mathbb E[\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2\mid Q_n,A_n]
 =\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+
 \operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^{\top}),
\]
and \(L_n=(Q_n^{\top}Q_n)^{-1}Q_n^{\top}\).  The added fluctuation calculation goes beyond this conditional-mean identity.  With \(B_n=L_nD_n\), \(H_n=B_n^{\top}B_n\), \(a_n=H_nu_n\), \(v_{ni}=m_{ni}(1-m_{ni})\), and
\[
 C_n=\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2-
 \{\|B_nu_n\|_2^2+\operatorname{tr}(B_nV_nB_n^{\top})\},
\]
it proves
\[
\begin{aligned}
 \operatorname{Var}(C_n\mid Q_n,A_n)
 ={}&4\sum_i a_{ni}^2v_{ni}
 +\sum_i h_{ii,n}^2v_{ni}(1-4v_{ni})
 +4\sum_{i<k}h_{ik,n}^2v_{ni}v_{nk}\\
 &+4\sum_i a_{ni}h_{ii,n}v_{ni}(1-2m_{ni})
\end{aligned}
\]
and the sufficient conditional-concentration bound
\[
 \mathbb P(|C_n|>t\mid Q_n,A_n)
 \le t^{-2}\{2\|H_nu_n\|_2^2+\tfrac12\|H_n\|_{\mathrm F}^2\}.
\]
Thus conditional concentration is reduced to explicit endogenous weighted-leverage controls, while the last summand in the variance formula records the coherent Bernoulli covariance correction.  What remains unproved is precisely that these leverage controls vanish and that the two conditional-mean terms possess deterministic limits for the original same-sample exponential tilts on an interval containing \(\kappa=1/8\).  No uniform interchange between the proportional limit and \(\kappa\downarrow0\), and hence no derivation of \(r_E=\kappa/(8\lambda)+o(\kappa)\), follows from the frozen results.
